gloss: year by year; every year; with each passing year

definitions.gloss: year by year; every year; with each passing year
definitions.explanation: Indicates something that happens each year, or a gradual change that progresses with each passing year.

examples.japanese: {年毎|としごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暑|あつ}く→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It gets hotter year by year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{年毎|としごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms bloom beautifully every year.

examples.japanese: {年毎|としごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel the children's growth with each passing year.

notes:
Typically used with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ as {年毎|としごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Part of a series of time-interval words using ⟦{毎|ごと}→〜毎：04012_goto⟧: {日毎|ひごと} (day by day), {月毎|つきごと} (month by month), {年毎|としごと} (year by year).

USAGE:
Used in two main patterns:
- {年毎|としごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + change: describes gradual change over years
- {年毎|としごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: describes something that recurs annually

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年毎|としごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧: to increase year by year
- {年毎|としごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: to change year by year
- {年毎|としごと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧: annual event

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧/{毎年|まいねん}: every year — simply states annual frequency, without the nuance of gradual change
- ⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧: year after year — very similar but more commonly used in written Japanese to describe progressive change
- {日毎|ひごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: day by day — the daily equivalent
